up: List the ChEMBL IDs and preferred names of all molecules reported in the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL4296182. Join the document to compound records using the document ID, then map those records to molecules via the molecule registry number.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4296182'
